author: M.H.C.Lichtenstein, 1823
summary: 우리나라에서는 서해의 무인도에서 한 번 잡힌 기록만 있는 미조로, 섬과 바닷가에 산다. 바다 위를 천천히 날다가 먹이를 발견하면 재빠르게 내리꽂혀 낚아챈다. 열대 지방에 분포하며, 타이완 등 동아시아, 남아프리카 열대 지방, 오스트레일리아 등지의 해안에서 볼 수 있다.
young: 어린새는 겨울깃 어른새처럼 이마가 희고 정수리에 검은 세로 얼룩이 있으며, 등·날개덮깃·셋째날개깃의 깃이 갈색을 띠고 가장자리가 희어 비늘 모양으로 보인다. 부리는 어른새보다 흐린 색이고 다리도 옅다.

art.subject: Greater Crested Tern (Thalasseus bergii), adult in breeding plumage, as in summer on the Korean west coast: black cap starting just behind a narrow white forehead band and ending in a shaggy crest on the nape; face, throat and neck white; mantle, back and upperwing medium grey, darker than in most terns, the outer primaries darker grey; rump and tail pale grey; underparts white. Bill long, heavy and cool greenish-yellow, slightly drooping at the tip; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: flying slowly low over the sea, about to plunge onto prey
art.scene: Uninhabited rocky island off Korea's west coast in summer, open sea and clear sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage (summer), side view standing on a rock: black cap with shaggy nape crest, narrow white forehead, white face, long yellow bill, medium grey back and wings, white underparts, black legs
adult breeding plumage, in flight over the sea seen from below and the side: black cap, long yellow bill, white underparts and underwing, darker tips to the outer primaries, forked grey tail
art.build: Large tern, about 46cm, roughly the length of a Black-tailed Gull but slimmer and longer-winged; flat crown ending in a shaggy black crest. Bill longer than the head, thick-based and dagger-shaped with a slightly drooping tip. Legs short, black. At rest the wingtips extend beyond the tail. Tail grey, moderately forked. Flight strong and purposeful on long, narrow, angled wings; plunge-dives for fish. In non-breeding plumage the forehead and forecrown are white and the black is reduced to a streaked rear crown and crest.
avoid: Do not paint an orange or red bill; Lesser Crested Tern has an orange bill and Caspian Tern a heavy red one.
Do not paint a black tip on the bill (Chinese Crested Tern, Thalasseus bernsteini).
Do not paint the adult's back brown; it is grey, and brown mottling belongs to juveniles.
Do not paint red or orange legs.
